model: Original procedural human-inspired external and internal heart; no scan or patient data.

colorSource.use: Continuous object-space projection mixed with geometry-aligned vascular grooves, epicardial fat and multiscale tissue fields.

maps.normal: 2048 tangent-space runtime, quality-95 WebP; full 4096 analytical bake retained
maps.surface: 2048 linear packed R occlusion, G roughness, B optical thickness

geometry: Surface grids, transported vascular tubes with lumen walls, sulcus-aligned coronaries and fat, four chambers, eleven valve leaflets, chordae and trabeculae. Meshopt and error-bounded simplification.
fluid: Illustrative pulsatile advection with one-way valve gates, velocity profiles, curved filling/ejection trajectories, chamber recirculation and advected bulk density. This is not a Navier–Stokes/CFD solution, patient-specific simulation or medical reference.
cells: Instanced biconcave erythrocytes, deliberately enlarged. 560 desktop / 240 mobile.

references.title: University of Minnesota, Atlas of Human Cardiac Anatomy — Right ventricle
University of Minnesota — Tricuspid valve
references.use: AV opening in diastole and closure in systole

references.title: University of Minnesota — Physiology tutorial
references.use: Chamber sequence, mitral/aortic route and cardiac cycle

validation: asset-verification.json, runtime-verification.json, webgl-verification.json; offline Cycles renders and actual WebGL screenshots are separately named.
